name: Over-long fit, length credit capped
description: Regression case. A 500 mm fit on a 50 mm shaft is L/d = 10. Torque capacity used to scale linearly with length forever, so this returned a required interference of 3.4 um with no comment. Pressure and micro-slip concentrate at the fit ends, so only L/d = 1.5 is credited and the answer should match the 75 mm case exactly, with a warning saying why.
